column3: With respect to the Washington Square Mortgage Loan (4.5%), the borrower and/or borrower sponsor is renovating a vacant former Sears (approximately 60,000 square feet) for the construction of a two-level, approximately 141,980 square foot DICK’s House of Sport with an additional 20,000 square feet for an exterior playing field adjacent to the improvements. Such renovations are not required or reserved for under the related loan documents. We cannot assure you as to the timing of such construction or as to whether or when such new store will open.
